facts: Study one-equivalent H2 addition to the three supplied neutral singlet molecular models in benzene at 298 K and 1 atm. Preserve the entire supplied graphs, including the N-phenyl and both SiMe3 groups of model 4. Use separated relaxed silylene plus H2 as the common reactant reference for each model; define the corresponding hydrogen-addition product. Vprime is a phenyl-substituted model of a bulkier experimental compound; models 1 and 4 are proposed structures. No measured H2 rates for these exact three models are supplied. Full bulky ligands, other substrates and catalytic cycles are outside scope.
scope: Only the three supplied models and one-equivalent H2 addition.
